description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Rousing Charge Mode III (Fire, Lightning, Earth)], [Frenzied Monk Mode] and Martial Will +5 to the user

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Rousing Charge Mode III (Fire, Lightning, Earth)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Earth 2 with Stacking] after using a Fire/Lightning/Earth ability

description.name: Frenzied Monk Mode
description.text: ATK +30%, critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient), casts Ballistic Fist after dealing a critical hit with an ability if the character has Martial Will level 1+
